children: Venus Liquidity Hub v1 is live on BNB Chain, providing a unified liquidity entry that allocates deposited capital across Core, Flux, and Fixed-Rate Vaults. Users deposit one asset and receive a Hub Token representing their position.

The single deposit position combines access to the three vault types within one capital-allocation layer. This could concentrate total value locked and user activity within the Venus protocol as liquidity enters through the Hub rather than through separate vault interfaces. The announcement does not specify direct value accrual to XVS, so the release does not state a change to the token's economics.

title: Venus: Liquidity Hub v1 goes live on BNB Chain - 31 Aug 2026
